questions: आपका नाम क्या है? | Aapka naam kya hai? | What is your name? | Who is your name? | Where is your name? | Which is your name?
मेरा नाम सरफराज है। | Mera naam Sarfraz hai. | My name is Sarfraz. | I name is Sarfraz. | Me name is Sarfraz. | My names Sarfraz.
आप किस क्लास में पढ़ते हैं? | Aap kis class mein padhte hain? | Which class do you study in? | What class do you study? | Where class do you study? | How class do you study?
मैं 10वीं कक्षा में पढ़ता हूँ। | Main 10th kaksha mein padhta hoon. | I study in 10th class. | I am study in 10th. | I studied in 10th class. | I am studying in 10th.
आप कहाँ रहते हैं? | Aap kahan rehte hain? | Where do you live? | What do you live? | Where are you live? | Where you live?
मैं दिल्ली में रहता हूँ। | Main Delhi mein rehta hoon. | I live in Delhi. | I am live in Delhi. | I lived in Delhi. | I am living in Delhi.
आपके पिता क्या करते हैं? | Aapke pita kya karte hain? | What does your father do? | What do your father do? | What is your father do? | What your father doing?
मेरे पिता डॉक्टर हैं। | Mere pita doctor hain. | My father is a doctor. | My father are doctor. | My father doctor is. | My father be doctor.
आपकी माता क्या करती हैं? | Aapki mata kya karti hain? | What does your mother do? | What do your mother do? | What is your mother do? | What your mother doing?
मेरी माता एक हाउसवाइफ हैं। | Meri mata ek housewife hain. | My mother is a housewife. | My mother are housewife. | My mother is housewife. | My mother be housewife.

आपके परिवार में कितने सदस्य हैं? | Aapke parivar mein kitne sadasya hain? | There are 5 members in my family. | There be 5 members in family. | There has 5 members in my family. | There is 5 members in my family.
आपके पिता क्या करते हैं? | Aapke pita kya karte hain? | My father is a teacher. | My father be a teacher. | My father are teacher. | My father is teacher.
आपकी माता क्या करती हैं? | Aapki mata kya karti hain? | My mother is a homemaker. | My mother be a homemaker. | My mother are homemaker. | My mother is homemaker.

आपके बड़े भाई क्या काम करते हैं? | Aapke bade bhai kya kaam karte hain? | My elder brother is working as a software engineer. | My elder brother working software engineer. | My elder brother is work as software engineer. | My elder brother be working as software engineer.
आपकी कितनी बहनें हैं? | Aapki kitni behnein hain? | I have two sisters. | I has two sisters. | I am two sisters. | I have two sister.

आपकी बड़ी बहन के बारे में क्या जानते हैं? | Aapki badi behan ke baare mein kya jaante hain? | My elder sister is married. | My elder sister be married. | My elder sister married. | My elder sister has married.

आपकी छोटी बहन क्या कर रही हैं? | Aapki choti behan kya kar rahi hain? | My younger sister is pursuing her graduation. | My younger sister pursuing her graduation. | My younger sister is pursue her graduation. | My younger sister be pursuing her graduation.
आप साथ में क्या करते हैं? | Aap saath mein kya karte hain? | We love spending time together. | We loves spending time together. | We is spending time together. | We love spend time together.
आप सब क्या खेल खेलते हैं? | Aap sab kya khel khelte hain? | We play games. | We plays games. | We is play games. | We playing games.

आप अपने परिवार के बारे में कैसा महसूस करते हैं? | Aap apne parivar ke baare mein kaisa mehsoos karte hain? | I love my family very much. | I loves my family very much. | I am love my family very much. | I love my family very many.
आप सुबह कब उठते हैं? | Aap subah kab uthte hain? | When do you wake up in the morning? | When you wake up morning? | When do you waking up? | What time you wake up morning?
क्या आप सुबह जल्दी उठते हैं? | Kya aap subah jaldi uthte hain? | Do you wake up early in the morning? | Do you waking up early? | Are you wake up early? | Does you wake up early?

उठने ke baad aap kya saaf karte hain? | Uthne ke baad aap kya saaf karte hain? | What do you clean after waking up? | What you clean after wake up? | What do you cleaning after wake up? | What does you clean after wake up?
क्या आप रोज़ ब्रश करते हैं? | Kya aap roz brush karte hain? | Do you brush your teeth everyday? | Do you brushing your teeth? | Does you brush your teeth? | Are you brush your teeth?

आप ब्रश करने के बाद क्या करते हैं? | Aap brush karne ke baad kya karte hain? | What do you do after brushing your teeth? | What you do after brush teeth? | What does you do after brush? | What are you doing after brush?
क्या आप रोज़ नहाते हैं? | Kya aap roz nahate hain? | Do you take a bath everyday? | Do you taking bath? | Are you take bath? | Does you take bath?

नहाने ke baad aap kahan jaane ke liye taiyar hote hain? | Nahane ke baad aap kahan jaane ke liye taiyar hote hain? | Where do you get dressed to go after taking a bath? | Where you get dress go bath? | Where do you getting dress after bath? | Where does you get dressed after bath?

क्या आप स्कूल के लिए तैयार होते हैं? | Kya aap school ke liye taiyar hote hain? | Do you get dressed for school? | Do you getting dress school? | Are you get dressed school? | Does you get dressed school?
आप सुबह का नाश्ता कब करते हैं? | Aap subah ka nashta kab karte hain? | When do you eat your breakfast? | When you eating breakfast? | When does you eat breakfast? | When are you eat breakfast?
क्या आप नाश्ते में फल खाते हैं? | Kya aap nashte mein fal khate hain? | Do you eat fruits in breakfast? | Do you eating fruit breakfast? | Are you eat fruit breakfast? | Does you eat fruit breakfast?
आप स्कूल किसके साथ जाते हैं? | Aap school kiske saath jaate hain? | With whom do you go to school? | With who you go school? | With whom you going school? | With who you going school?

क्या आप अपने दोस्तों के साथ स्कूल जाते हैं? | Kya aap apne doston ke saath school jaate hain? | Do you go to school with your friends? | Do you going school friend? | Are you go school friend? | Does you go school friend?
आप कक्षा में क्या करते हैं? | Aap kaksha mein kya karte hain? | What do you do in class? | What you do in class? | What does you do in class? | What are you doing in class?

क्या आप कक्षा में ध्यान से पढ़ाई करते हैं? | Kya aap kaksha mein dhyan se padhai karte hain? | Do you study carefully in class? | Do you studying carefully class? | Are you study carefully class? | Does you study carefully class?
आप दोपहर का भोजन कब करते हैं? | Aap dopahar ka bhojan kab karte hain? | When do you have your lunch? | When you having lunch? | When does you have lunch? | When are you have lunch?
आप शाम को कहाँ खेलते हैं? | Aap shaam ko kahan khelte hain? | Where do you play in the evening? | Where you play evening? | Where does you play evening? | Where are you playing evening?

क्या आप शाम को दोस्तों के साथ खेलते हैं? | Kya aap shaam ko doston ke saath khelte hain? | Do you play with friends in the evening? | Do you playing friend evening? | Are you play friend evening? | Does you play friend evening?

खेलने ke baad aap kaun sa karya karte hain? | Khelne ke baad aap kaun sa karya karte hain? | Which work do you do after playing? | What work you do after play? | What work does you do after play? | Which work are you doing after play?
आप रात का खाना किसके साथ खाते हैं? | Aap raat ka khana kiske saath khate hain? | With whom do you eat dinner? | With who you eat dinner? | With whom you eating dinner? | With who you eating dinner?
क्या आप रात को जल्दी सो जाते हैं? | Kya aap raat ko jaldi so jaate hain? | Do you go to bed early at night? | Do you going bed early? | Are you go bed early? | Does you go bed early?
आप सुबह कितने बजे उठते हैं? | Aap subah kitne baje uthte hain? | What time do you wake up in the morning? | What time you waking up? | What time does you wake up? | What time are you wake up?

क्या आप सुबह सात बजे उठते हैं? | Kya aap subah saat baje uthte hain? | Do you wake up at seven o'clock in the morning? | Do you wake up on seven o'clock? | Are you wake up at seven o'clock? | Does you wake up at seven o'clock?

उठने ke baad aap kahan jaate hain? | Uthne ke baad aap kahan jaate hain? | Where do you go after waking up? | Where you go after wake up? | Where does you go after wake up? | Where are you go after wake up?
क्या आप सुबह कसरत करते हैं? | Kya aap subah kasrat karte hain? | Do you do exercise in the morning? | Do you doing exercise morning? | Are you do exercise morning? | Does you do exercise morning?

कसरत karne ke baad aap kya khaate hain? | Kasrat karne ke baad aap kya khaate hain? | What do you eat after doing exercise? | What you eat after do exercise? | What does you eat after do exercise? | What are you eating after exercise?

क्या आप सुबह की हवा का आनंद लेने बाहर जाते हैं? | Kya aap subah ki hawa ka anand lene bahar jaate hain? | Do you go outside to enjoy the morning air? | Do you go outside enjoy morning air? | Are you go outside enjoy morning air? | Does you go outside enjoy morning air?
आप पार्क में किससे मिलते हैं? | Aap park mein kisse milte hain? | Whom do you meet in the park? | Who you meet in park? | Whom does you meet in park? | Whom are you meet in park?
क्या आप अपने दोस्तों से मिलते हैं? | Kya aap apne doston se milte hain? | Do you meet with your friends? | Do you meet your friends? | Are you meet your friends? | Does you meet your friends?

दोस्तों से मिलने ke baad aap kiske liye taiyar hote hain? | Doston se milne ke baad aap kiske liye taiyar hote hain? | For what do you get ready after meeting friends? | What you get ready after meet friend? | What do you get ready after meet? | What does you get ready after meeting?

आप अपनी ऑफिस कैब का इंतज़ार कहाँ करते हैं? | Aap apni office cab ka intezaar kahan karte hain? | Where do you wait for your office cab? | Where you wait for office cab? | Where does you wait for office cab? | Where are you waiting for office cab?

सिंपल प्रेजेंट टेंस का मुख्य उपयोग क्या है? | Simple Present tense ka mukhya upyog kya hai? | Habits, daily routines, or facts. | Only for future plans. | Only for past actions. | To describe actions happening right now.
सिंपल प्रेजेंट टेंस की पहचान क्या है? | Simple Present tense ki pehchan kya hai? | ...ता है / ती है / ते हैं. | ...रहा है / रही है / रहे हैं. | ...चुका है / चुकी है. | ...से रहा है.
सिंपल प्रेजेंट टेंस का बेसिक इंग्लिश रूल क्या है? | Simple Present tense ka basic English rule kya hai? | Subject + Verb. | Subject + is + Verb. | Subject + was + Verb. | Subject + has + Verb.
सिंगुलर सब्जेक्ट (He/She/It) के साथ वर्ब में क्या जोड़ा जाता है? | Singular subject (He/She/It) ke saath verb mein kya joda jaata hai? | Add s/es. | Add ed. | Add ing. | Nothing is added.
वह स्कूल जाता है - इसका सही इंग्लिश अनुवाद क्या है? | Vah school jaata hai - iska sahi English anuvaad kya hai? | He goes to school. | He go to school. | He going to school. | He gone to school.

हम क्रिकेट खेलते हैं - इसका सही इंग्लिश अनुवाद क्या है? | Hum cricket khelte hain - iska sahi English anuvaad kya hai? | We play cricket. | We plays cricket. | We playing cricket. | We played cricket.

'He goes to school' में वर्ब के साथ 'es' क्यों लगा है? | 'He goes to school' mein verb ke saath 'es' kyon laga hai? | Because the subject 'He' is singular. | Because it is a past action. | Because it is a question. | Because it is plural.

दिए गए इमेज में 'Simple Present Tense' को किस नाम से पुकारा गया है? | Diye gaye image mein 'Simple Present Tense' ko kis naam se pukara gaya hai? | The Routine Floor. | The Live Camera Floor. | The Clock Tense. | The Past Floor.
वह स्कूल जाता है - इसका रोमन हिंदी क्या है? | Vah school jaata hai - iska Roman Hindi kya hai? | Vah school jata hai. | He school go. | Vah school going. | Vah school ja raha hai.
हम क्रिकेट खेलते हैं - इसका रोमन हिंदी क्या है? | Hum cricket khelte hain - iska Roman Hindi kya hai? | Hum cricket khelte hain. | We cricket play. | Hum cricket khel raha hai. | Hum cricket khela.

day6.topic: Present Continuous Tense (The Live Camera Floor)
questions: प्रेजेंट कंटीन्यूअस टेंस का मुख्य कार्य क्या है? | Present Continuous tense ka mukhya karya kya hai? | Actions happening right now, at this exact second. | Actions that happened in the past. | Actions that will happen in the future. | General habits.
प्रेजेंट कंटीन्यूअस टेंस की पहचान क्या है? | Present Continuous tense ki pehchan kya hai? | ...रहा है / रही है / रहे हैं. | ...ता है / ती है / ते हैं. | ...चुका है / चुकी है. | ...से रहा है.

प्रेजेंट कंटीन्यूअस टेंस का इंग्लिश रूल क्या है? | Present Continuous tense ka English rule kya hai? | Subject + is/am/are + Verb-ing. | Subject + Verb. | Subject + has/have + V3. | Subject + will + Verb.
वह स्कूल जा रहा है - इसका इंग्लिश रूटीन क्या है? | Vah school ja raha hai - iska English routine kya hai? | He is going to school. | He goes to school. | He gone to school. | He go to school.

हम क्रिकेट खेल रहे हैं - इसका सही इंग्लिश अनुवाद क्या है? | Hum cricket khel rahe hain - iska sahi English anuvaad kya hai? | We are playing cricket. | We play cricket. | We played cricket. | We will play cricket.
उसने इनाम जीता है - इसका इंग्लिश रूटीन क्या है? | Usne inaam jeeta hai - iska English routine kya hai? | He has won the prize. | He is winning the prize. | He wins the prize. | He won the prize.

दिए गए इमेज में प्रेजेंट कंटीन्यूअस टेंस को किस फ्लोर के नाम से जाना गया है? | Diye gaye image mein Present Continuous tense ko kis floor ke naam se jaana gaya hai? | The Live Camera Floor. | The Routine Floor. | The Clock Tense. | The Past Floor.
इस टेंस में 'is/am/are' के साथ वर्ब में क्या जोड़ा जाता है? | Is tense mein 'is/am/are' ke saath verb mein kya joda jaata hai? | -ing. | -ed. | -s/es. | Nothing.
वह स्कूल जा रहा है - इसका रोमन हिंदी क्या है? | Vah school ja raha hai - iska Roman Hindi kya hai? | Vah school ja raha hai. | Vah school jata hai. | Vah school gaya. | Vah school jayega.

उसने इनाम जीता है - इसमें कौन सा इंग्लिश रूल इस्तेमाल हुआ है? | Usne inaam jeeta hai - isme kaun sa English rule istemaal hua hai? | Subject + has/have + Past Participle. | Subject + is/am/are + Verb-ing. | Subject + Verb. | Subject + will + Verb.

day7.topic: Present Perfect Continuous Tense (The Clock Tense)
questions: प्रेजेंट परफेक्ट कंटीन्यूअस टेंस का मुख्य कार्य क्या है? | Present Perfect Continuous tense ka mukhya karya kya hai? | Started in the past, still running now. | Actions happening right now. | Actions in the future. | Actions that finished.
इस टेंस की पहचान क्या है? | Is tense ki pehchan kya hai? | [Time] से ...रहा है / रही है / रहे हैं. | ...ता है / ती है. | ...चुका है / चुकी है. | ...रहा है (no time).
इसका इंग्लिश रूल क्या है? | Iska English rule kya hai? | Subject + has been / have been + Verb-ing + since / for. | Subject + is + Verb-ing. | Subject + has + V3. | Subject + Verb.

वह सुबह से स्कूल जा रहा है - इसका इंग्लिश रूटीन क्या है? | Vah subah se school ja raha hai - iska English routine kya hai? | He has been going to school since morning. | He is going to school. | He goes to school. | He has gone to school.

वह सुबह से स्कूल जा रहा है - इसका रोमन हिंदी क्या है? | Vah subah se school ja raha hai - iska Roman Hindi kya hai? | Vah subah se school ja raha hai. | Vah school jata hai. | Vah school ja raha hai. | Vah school jayega.

हम दो घंटे से क्रिकेट खेल रहे हैं - इसका इंग्लिश रूटीन क्या है? | Hum do ghante se cricket khel rahe hain - iska English routine kya hai? | We have been playing cricket for two hours. | We are playing cricket. | We play cricket. | We have played cricket.

हम दो घंटे से क्रिकेट खेल रहे हैं - इसका रोमन हिंदी क्या है? | Hum do ghante se cricket khel rahe hain - iska Roman Hindi kya hai? | Hum do ghante se cricket khel rahe hain. | Hum cricket khel rahe hain. | Hum cricket khelte hain. | Hum cricket khelenge.

क्या इस टेंस में 'since' या 'for' का उपयोग होता है? | Kya is tense mein 'since' ya 'for' ka upyog hota hai? | Haan, samay batane ke liye. | Nahi, kabhi nahi. | Sirf Past tense mein. | Sirf Future tense mein.

यदि हिंदी वाक्य 'रहा है' पर समाप्त होता है, तो इंग्लिश स्ट्रक्चर क्या होगा? | Yadi hindi vakya 'raha hai' par samapt hota hai, to English structure kya hoga? | is / am / are + Verb-ing. | has been + Verb-ing. | Verb + s/es. | had + V3.

यदि हिंदी वाक्य 'चुका है' पर समाप्त होता है, तो इंग्लिश स्ट्रक्चर क्या होगा? | Yadi hindi vakya 'chuka hai' par samapt hota hai, to English structure kya hoga? | has / have + V3. | is + Verb-ing. | has been + Verb-ing. | Verb.

थर्ड-पर्सन सिंगुलर (He/She/It/Ram) के पॉजिटिव सेंटेंस का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Third-Person Singular (He/She/It/Ram) ke positive sentence ka structure kya hai? | Subject + plays + football. | Subject + play + football. | Subject + is + play. | Subject + does + play.

थर्ड-पर्सन सिंगुलर नेगेटिव सेंटेंस का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Third-person singular negative sentence ka structure kya hai? | Subject + does + not + play + football. | Subject + do + not + play. | Subject + is + not + play. | Subject + play.

थर्ड-पर्सन सिंगुलर इंटरोगेटिव (सवाल) का क्या स्ट्रक्चर है? | Third-person singular interrogative (sawaal) ka kya structure hai? | Does + subject + play + football?. | Do + subject + play + football?. | Is + subject + playing?. | Did + subject + play?.

प्लुरल नंबर (I/We/They/You) के लिए पॉजिटिव सेंटेंस क्या है? | Plural number (I/We/They/You) ke liye positive sentence kya hai? | Subject + play + football. | Subject + plays + football. | Subject + is + play. | Subject + playing.

प्लुरल नेगेटिव सेंटेंस का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Plural negative sentence ka structure kya hai? | Subject + do + not + play + football. | Subject + does + not + play. | Subject + not + play. | Subject + is + play.
थर्ड-पर्सन सिंगुलर में नेगेटिव सेंटेंस के लिए किसका प्रयोग होता है? | Third-person singular mein negative sentence ke liye kiska prayog hota hai? | does not. | do not. | is not. | am not.

प्लुरल इंटरोगेटिव का क्या स्ट्रक्चर है? | Plural interrogative ka kya structure hai? | Do + subject + play + football?. | Does + subject + play + football?. | Is + subject + playing?. | Did + subject + play?.

सिंगुलर में एम्फैटिक (Emphatic) सेंटेंस का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Singular mein Emphatic sentence ka structure kya hai? | Subject + does + play + football. | Subject + play + football. | Subject + is + play. | Subject + playing.

प्लुरल WH-क्वेश्चन सेंटेंस का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Plural WH-question sentence ka structure kya hai? | WH word + do + subject + play + football?. | WH word + does + subject + play + football?. | WH word + is + subject + playing?. | WH word + did + play?.
क्या 'Ram' थर्ड-पर्सन सिंगुलर है? | Kya 'Ram' third-person singular hai? | Haan. | Nahi. | Plural hai. | Sirf I/We/They hain.

आपके शौक क्या हैं? - इंग्लिश में कैसे पूछेंगे? | Aapke shauk kya hain? - English mein kaise poochhenge? | What are your hobbies?. | How are your hobbies?. | Where are your hobbies?. | Who are your hobbies?.

यह आपका शौक क्यों है? - इंग्लिश में कैसे पूछेंगे? | Yeh aapka shauk kyon hai? - English mein kaise poochhenge? | Why is it your hobby?. | What is your hobby?. | How is your hobby?. | Where is your hobby?.

आपने यह शौक कैसे शुरू किया? - इंग्लिश में कैसे पूछेंगे? | Aapne yeh shauk kaise shuru kiya? - English mein kaise poochhenge? | How did you develop this hobby?. | What did you develop?. | Why did you develop?. | Where did you develop?.

आप अपने शौक के लिए कितना समय निकालते हैं? - इंग्लिश में कैसे पूछेंगे? | Aap apne shauk ke liye kitna samay nikalte hain? - English mein kaise poochhenge? | How much time do you spend on your hobby?. | What time do you spend?. | Why time do you spend?. | Where time do you spend?.

काम के अलावा आपके और क्या शौक हैं? - इंग्लिश में कैसे पूछेंगे? | Kaam ke alawa aapke aur kya shauk hain? - English mein kaise poochhenge? | What hobbies do you have besides work/study?. | What work do you have?. | Why hobbies do you have?. | Where hobbies do you have?.
शौक के बारे में जवाब देते समय क्या टिप दी गई है? | Shauk ke baare mein jawab dete samay kya tip di gayi hai? | Be honest and natural. | Keep it long. | Lie if needed. | No need to explain.

क्या इंटरव्यू में शौक के बारे में पूछना जरूरी है? | Kya interview mein shauk ke baare mein poochhna zaroori hai? | Haan, yeh shakhsiyat aur kaam-jeevan santulan dikhata hai. | Nahi, yeh bekaar hai. | Sirf bade jobs ke liye. | Sirf school ke liye.
उपयोगी वाक्यांश (Useful Phrases) में कौन सा है? | Upyogi vakyaansh (Useful Phrases) mein kaun sa hai? | I am passionate about.... | I hate it.... | It is bad.... | It gives nothing....
क्या आप अपने शौक के उदाहरण दे सकते हैं? | Kya aap apne shauk ke udaharan de sakte hain? | Yes (Reading, Traveling, Music, Sports). | No. | I don't know. | Only dancing.

आप क्या शौक विकसित करना चाहते हैं? - इंग्लिश में कैसे पूछेंगे? | Aap kya shauk viksit karna chahte hain? - English mein kaise poochhenge? | What new hobby would you like to try in the future?. | What hobby you have?. | Why hobby you want?. | How hobby you try?.

अपना परिचय दें - इंग्लिश में कैसे कहेंगे? | Apna parichay dein - English mein kaise kahenge? | Introduce yourself. | Walk me through your profile. | Both (Introduce yourself / Walk me through your profile). | None.
अगर आप अकेले बच्चे हैं, तो कैसे कहेंगे? | Agar aap akele bachche hain, to kaise kahenge? | I am the only child. | I have siblings. | I have no family. | I am a twin.

आपके पिता क्या करते हैं? - इस सवाल का जवाब देने का तरीका क्या है? | Aapke pita kya karte hain? - Is sawaal ka jawab dene ka tareeka kya hai? | My father runs a business / is a government employee. | My father is a student. | My father is not working. | I don't know.

आपकी माता कहाँ काम करती हैं? - सही जवाब कैसे देंगे? | Aapki mata kahan kaam karti hain? - Sahi jawab kaise denge? | My mother works in the private sector. | My mother is a doctor. | My mother is a student. | My mother is not working.
क्या 'dancing' एक शौक हो सकता है? | Kya 'dancing' ek shauk ho sakta hai? | Haan. | Nahi. | Sirf singing hota hai. | Sirf playing hota hai.
अगर आपको स्पेलिंग पूछनी हो, तो कैसे पूछेंगे? | Agar aapko spelling poochhni ho, to kaise poochhenge? | Could you please spell 'recite' out?. | Say 'recite'. | 'Recite' spelling?. | Tell me 'recite'.
अगर आप समझ गए तो कैसे कहेंगे? | Agar aap samajh gaye to kaise kahenge? | I understand / I got it. | Yes. | Good. | Okay.
इंटरव्यू में 'detail-oriented' का क्या अर्थ है? | Interview mein 'detail-oriented' ka kya arth hai? | Dhyan se kaam karne wala. | Jo kaam na kare. | Jo jaldi bhool jaye. | Lazy.
क्या 'corporate sector' में भी पिता काम कर सकते हैं? | Kya 'corporate sector' mein bhi pita kaam kar sakte hain? | Haan. | Nahi. | Sirf government mein. | Sirf private mein.
क्या परिचय देते समय व्यक्तिगत जानकारी देनी चाहिए? | Kya parichay dete samay vyaktigat jaankari deni chahiye? | Haan, agar zaroori ho. | Nahi, bilkul nahi. | Sirf naam. | Sirf age.

सब्जेक्ट (कर्ता) की परिभाषा क्या है? | Subject (karta) ki paribhasha kya hai? | Sentence mein jo insaan, jaanwar ya cheez koi kaam karta hai, use Subject kehte hain. | Sentence mein jo kaam ho raha hai. | Helping verb ko subject kehte hain. | Main verb ko subject kehte hain.
हेल्पिंग वर्ब का क्या कार्य है? | Helping verb ka kya karya hai? | Ye batate hain ki kaam kab ho raha hai. | Ye sirf naam batate hain. | Ye action batate hain. | Ye sirf question puchne ke liye hai.
मेन वर्ब किसे कहते हैं? | Main verb kise kehte hain? | Sentence mein jo asli action ho raha hota hai. | Jo helping verb hota hai. | Jo subject hota hai. | Jo object hota hai.
नेगेटिव सेंटेंस में 'NOT' कहाँ लगता है? | Negative sentence mein 'NOT' kahan lagta hai? | Teesre (3rd) number par. | Pehle number par. | Dusre number par. | Aakhri mein.
पॉजिटिव सेंटेंस का सही फ़ॉर्मूला क्या है? | Positive sentence ka sahi formula kya hai? | Sub + H.V. + Verb. | Sub + Verb + H.V. | Verb + Sub + H.V. | H.V. + Sub + Verb.
प्रेजेंट टेंस की हेल्पिंग वर्ब्स कौन सी हैं? | Present tense ki helping verbs kaun si hain? | Is, Am, Are, Do, Does, Has, Have. | Was, Were, Did, Had. | Will, Shall. | Can, Could, May.
पास्ट टेंस पहचानने के लिए किन शब्दों का उपयोग होता है? | Past tense pehchanne ke liye kin shabdon ka upyog hota hai? | Was, Were, Did, Had. | Is, Am, Are. | Will, Shall. | Has, Have.
फ्यूचर टेंस के लिए कौन से शब्द हैं? | Future tense ke liye kaun se shabd hain? | Will, Shall. | Was, Were. | Is, Am, Are. | Do, Does.

क्या हेल्पिंग वर्ब से टेंस का पता चलता है? | Kya helping verb se tense ka pata chalta hai? | Haan, tense, mood, aur ability ka pata chalta hai. | Nahi, sirf naam ka pata chalta hai. | Nahi, sirf action ka. | Sirf question ke liye.
I can go का हिंदी अनुवाद क्या है? | I can go ka hindi anuvaad kya hai? | Main ja sakta hoon. | Main ja raha hoon. | Main gaya. | Main jaunga.
सिंपल प्रेजेंट टेंस का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Simple Present tense ka structure kya hai? | Sub + V1 + Obj. | Sub + V2 + Obj. | Sub + will + V1 + Obj. | Sub + is + V-ing + Obj.
प्रेजेंट कंटीन्यूअस टेंस में क्या हेल्पिंग वर्ब लगती है? | Present Continuous tense mein kya helping verb lagti hai? | am/is/are. | has/have. | was/were. | will be.
पास्ट परफेक्ट टेंस का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Past Perfect tense ka structure kya hai? | Sub + had + V3 + Obj. | Sub + have + V3. | Sub + has + V3. | Sub + will have + V3.
फ्यूचर परफेक्ट टेंस का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Future Perfect tense ka structure kya hai? | Sub + will have + V3 + Obj. | Sub + had + V3. | Sub + has + V3. | Sub + have + V3.
सिंपल पास्ट की पहचान (Pehchan) क्या है? | Simple Past ki pehchan kya hai? | Kaam poora ho gaya. | Action chal raha hai. | Habit. | Future plan.
प्रेजेंट परफेक्ट कंटीन्यूअस का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Present Perfect Continuous ka structure kya hai? | Sub + has/have been + V-ing + Obj. | Sub + is + V-ing. | Sub + had + V3. | Sub + will + V-ing.
पास्ट कंटीन्यूअस टेंस का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Past Continuous tense ka structure kya hai? | Sub + was/were + V-ing + Obj. | Sub + is + V-ing. | Sub + has + V-ing. | Sub + will + V-ing.
सिंपल फ्यूचर का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Simple Future ka structure kya hai? | Sub + will + V1 + Obj. | Sub + V1. | Sub + V2. | Sub + will + V-ing.
फ्यूचर कंटीन्यूअस टेंस का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Future Continuous tense ka structure kya hai? | Sub + will be + V-ing + Obj. | Sub + will + V-ing. | Sub + will have + V3. | Sub + is + V-ing.

नेगेटिव सेंटेंस, पास्ट टेंस के लिए स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Negative sentence, Past tense ke liye structure kya hai? | Sub + did not + V1 + Obj. | Sub + do not + V1. | Sub + is not + V1. | Sub + will not + V1.
इंपरेटिव सेंटेंस का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Imperative sentence ka structure kya hai? | V1 + Object. | Sub + V1. | V1 + Sub. | Object + V1.
कमांड के लिए क्या एग्जांपल है? | Command ke liye kya example hai? | Eat a mango. | Please eat. | Study hard. | Open door.
रिक्वेस्ट के लिए 'Please' का उपयोग कहाँ होता है? | Request ke liye 'Please' ka upyog kahan hota hai? | Please eat a mango. | Eat please. | Mango eat please. | Please mango eat.
एडवाइस के लिए क्या एग्जांपल दिया गया है? | Advice ke liye kya example diya gaya hai? | Study hard. | Eat mango. | Open door. | Come here.
एक्सक्लेमेटरी सेंटेंस का क्या कार्य है? | Exclamatory sentence ka kya karya hai? | Strong Feeling (tivra bhavna). | Request. | Advice. | Command.
एक्सक्लेमेटरी सेंटेंस का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Exclamatory sentence ka structure kya hai? | What/How + Expression + !. | V1 + Object. | Sub + V1. | Object + V1.
आश्चर्य (Surprise) के लिए क्या एग्जांपल है? | Surprise ke liye kya example hai? | What a sweet mango!. | How beautiful!. | What a player!. | How fast!.
प्रशंसा (Admiration) के लिए क्या एग्जांपल है? | Admiration ke liye kya example hai? | How beautiful this flower is!. | What a mango!. | What a player!. | How fast!.
तारीफ (Praise) के लिए क्या एग्जांपल है? | Praise ke liye kya example hai? | What a great player!. | What a mango!. | How beautiful!. | How fast!.
एक्सक्लेमेटरी सेंटेंस की पहचान क्या है? | Exclamatory sentence ki pehchan kya hai? | End mein ! (exclamation mark) lagta hai. | End mein . lagta hai. | End mein ? lagta hai. | End mein , lagta hai.
वर्ब के अंत में 's-ch-x' या 'z-o-sh' हो तो क्या जोड़ते हैं? | Verb ke end mein 's-ch-x' ya 'z-o-sh' ho to kya jodte hain? | 'es' jodte hain. | 's' jodte hain. | 'ing' jodte hain. | 'ed' jodte hain.
सब्जेक्ट 'He' के साथ गो (go) का क्या रूप होगा? | Subject 'He' ke saath go ka kya roop hoga? | goes. | go. | going. | gone.
'In' का उपयोग किस संदर्भ में होता है? | 'In' ka upyog kis sandarbh mein hota hai? | Inside (pehle se andar). | Movement. | Future. | Past.
'Into' का उपयोग किस संदर्भ में होता है? | 'Into' ka upyog kis sandarbh mein hota hai? | Andar jaana (movement). | Inside (pehle se andar). | Future. | Past.

Adjective + Noun होने पर 'What' का उपयोग कैसे करते हैं? | Adjective + Noun hone par 'What' ka upyog kaise karte hain? | What + a/an + Adjective + Noun!. | How + Adjective + Noun!. | What + Noun!. | How + Adjective!.

अगर सिर्फ Adjective हो तो 'How' का प्रयोग कैसे करते हैं? | Agar sirf Adjective ho to 'How' ka prayog kaise karte hain? | How + Adjective + Subject + Verb!. | What + Adjective + Subject + Verb!. | How + Noun!. | What + Noun!.
वॉच (watch) में 'es' क्यों जोड़ा गया है? | Watch mein 'es' kyon joda gaya hai? | Kyunki 'ch' par end ho raha hai. | Kyunki vowel hai. | Kyunki 's' hai. | Kyunki 'x' hai.
प्रीपोजिशन 'in' का एग्जांपल क्या है? | Preposition 'in' ka example kya hai? | I am in my room. | I walked in the room. | I go in room. | Room in me.
क्या 'into' गति (movement) को दर्शाता है? | Kya 'into' gati (movement) ko darshata hai? | Haan, jaise 'walked into the room'. | Nahi. | Sirf in hota hai. | Sirf andar.
हाउ (How) का प्रयोग करने का क्या नियम है? | How ka prayog karne ka kya niyam hai? | Adjective par zor ho aur Noun na ho. | Noun par zor ho. | Verb par zor ho. | Adverb par zor ho.
सुबह जल्दी उठने को इंग्लिश में क्या कहेंगे? | Subah jaldi uthne ko English mein kya kahenge? | I woke up early in the morning. | I sleep early. | I take bath. | I go to school.
दांत साफ करने का इंग्लिश वाक्य क्या है? | Daant saaf karne ka English vakya kya hai? | I brushed my teeth. | I take bath. | I eat breakfast. | I play.
स्नान करने को इंग्लिश में कैसे लिखेंगे? | Snan karne ko English mein kaise likhenge? | I took a bath. | I brushed teeth. | I studied. | I ate dinner.
स्कूल के लिए तैयार होने का इंग्लिश अनुवाद क्या है? | School ke liye taiyar hone ka English anuvaad kya hai? | I got dressed for school. | I went to school. | I ate breakfast. | I played.
नाश्ता करने को इंग्लिश में क्या कहेंगे? | Nashta karne ko English mein kya kahenge? | I ate breakfast. | I had lunch. | I ate dinner. | I brushed teeth.
स्कूल जाने को इंग्लिश में क्या कहेंगे? | School jaane ko English mein kya kahenge? | I went to school with my friends. | I studied in class. | I did homework. | I woke up.
कक्षा में पढ़ाई करने का इंग्लिश वाक्य क्या है? | Kaksha mein padhai karne ka English vakya kya hai? | I studied in class. | I went to school. | I had lunch. | I played.
दोपहर का भोजन करने को इंग्लिश में क्या कहेंगे? | Dopahar ka bhojan karne ko English mein kya kahenge? | I had lunch. | I ate breakfast. | I ate dinner. | I took a bath.
शाम को खेलने को इंग्लिश में क्या कहेंगे? | Shaam ko khelne ko English mein kya kahenge? | I played in the evening. | I did homework. | I went to school. | I studied.
होमवर्क करने का इंग्लिश अनुवाद क्या है? | Homework karne ka English anuvaad kya hai? | I did my homework. | I ate dinner. | I went to bed. | I brushed teeth.

day16.topic: Modals and Phrasals: Obligation and Habit
questions: 'Have to' का प्रयोग किसके लिए होता है? | 'Have to' ka prayog kiske liye hota hai? | Present Obligation. | Past Habit. | Strong Advice. | Preference.
'Used to' का प्रयोग किसके लिए होता है? | 'Used to' ka prayog kiske liye hota hai? | Past Habit. | Present Obligation. | Expectation. | Advice.
'Had to' का प्रयोग किसके लिए होता है? | 'Had to' ka prayog kiske liye hota hai? | Past Obligation. | Present Obligation. | Past Habit. | Preference.
He has to study for exams का हिंदी मतलब क्या है? | He has to study for exams ka Hindi matlab kya hai? | Mujhe pariksha ke liye padhna hai. | Mujhe khelna hai. | Mujhe sona hai. | Mujhe khana hai.
'Ought to' का क्या मतलब है? | 'Ought to' ka kya matlab hai? | Moral Obligation. | Past Habit. | Expectation. | Preference.
'Had better' का क्या मतलब है? | 'Had better' ka kya matlab hai? | Strong Advice. | Past Obligation. | Present Obligation. | Past Habit.
'Would rather' का क्या मतलब है? | 'Would rather' ka kya matlab hai? | Preference. | Strong Advice. | Expectation. | Past Habit.
'Supposed to' का क्या मतलब है? | 'Supposed to' ka kya matlab hai? | Expectation. | Strong Advice. | Past Obligation. | Preference.
'Be to' का प्रयोग किस लिए होता है? | 'Be to' ka prayog kis liye hota hai? | Scheduled Arrangement. | Past Habit. | Present Obligation. | Moral Obligation.

I used to ride a bicycle - इसका हिंदी अनुवाद क्या है? | I used to ride a bicycle - iska Hindi anuvaad kya hai? | Main cycle chalaya karta tha. | Mujhe cycle chalani hai. | Main cycle chala raha hoon. | Main cycle chalaunga.
I have eaten का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | I have eaten ka structure kya hai? | Subject + have/has + V3. | Subject + V1. | Subject + V2. | Subject + will + V1.
I have not eaten का मतलब क्या है? | I have not eaten ka matlab kya hai? | Maine nahi khaya hai. | Maine khaya hai. | Main kha raha hoon. | Main khaunga.
Have I eaten? का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | Have I eaten? ka structure kya hai? | Have/Has + Subject + V3?. | Subject + have + V3. | Have + V3 + Subject. | V3 + Subject + Have.
I have to eat का स्ट्रक्चर क्या है? | I have to eat ka structure kya hai? | Subject + have/has to + V1. | Subject + V3. | Subject + V1. | Subject + V2.
V3 का पूरा नाम क्या है? | V3 ka poora naam kya hai? | Past Participle. | Present Participle. | Base Form. | Verb One.

When it rains, I will take a bath - इसमें कौन सा स्ट्रक्चर है? | When it rains, I will take a bath - isme kaun sa structure hai? | When + Present Simple, Subject + will + V1. | When + Past, Subject + V2. | When + V1, Subject + V2. | When + Future, Subject + Present.
Maine khaya hai - इसे इंग्लिश में क्या कहेंगे? | Maine khaya hai - ise English mein kya kahenge? | I have eaten. | I ate. | I eat. | I will eat.
क्या 'have to' के साथ V1 का प्रयोग होता है? | Kya 'have to' ke saath V1 ka prayog hota hai? | Haan. | Nahi. | Sirf V2. | Sirf V3.
I have certainly eaten - इसमें क्या जोड़ा गया है? | I have certainly eaten - isme kya joda gaya hai? | certainly. | not. | will. | had.
Why have I eaten? - किस प्रकार का वाक्य है? | Why have I eaten? - kis prakar ka vakya hai? | Question (WH-Question). | Positive. | Negative. | Command.
क्वेश्चन टैग का क्या उपयोग है? | Question tag ka kya upyog hai? | To confirm something or to invite agreement. | To ask long questions. | To give commands. | To describe feelings.
यदि सेंटेंस पॉजिटिव है, तो टैग क्या होगा? | Yadi sentence positive hai, to tag kya hoga? | The tag is negative. | The tag is positive. | No tag is used. | The tag is neutral.
यदि सेंटेंस नेगेटिव है, तो टैग क्या होगा? | Yadi sentence negative hai, to tag kya hoga? | The tag is positive. | The tag is negative. | No tag is used. | The tag is neutral.
I am your friend का क्वेश्चन टैग क्या होगा? | I am your friend ka question tag kya hoga? | aren't I?. | am not I?. | am I?. | isn't I?.
